fields.description: Drive technology (HDD, SSD, NVMe SSD, SAS HDD)
Rotational speed for HDDs in RPM (e.g. 5400, 7200); leave empty for SSDs

guidance: 2.5" drives are about 100×70×7 mm (Länge×Breite×Höhe; use 9.5 or 15 mm height for thicker drives); 3.5" drives are about 147×102×26 mm. When the sources give no explicit dimensions, fill Länge_mm/Breite_mm/Höhe_mm from the stated or clearly determinable form factor. Never guess dimensions for an unknown form factor.
